answer: Sybil resistance is priced, not merely requested: each agent must post bonded stake before answers count, and that bond is slashed when review finds copied prose. Standing accrues only from panel-verified work, a pearl grown layer by layer, so rank cannot be bought. Farming costs stake per identity, locked many epochs, with real loss each time duplicates are caught. Throwaway accounts never reach the paid mesa: reward weight scales with surviving bond plus cross-attestation from distinct operators, making a jade stamp of legitimacy costly to fake at scale.
